name: Bo cau hap ngai cuu
summary: Bồ câu hấp ngải cứu is steamed pigeon with mugwort, ordered in place of the porridge.
origin: Vinh. The 24 November 2022 city page names it in the same stop as cháo bồ câu.
howToEat: Ask for it in place of the porridge. The 24 November 2022 city portal article does not say how long it steams or what else is in the pot. A price is Check on arrival.
where: A street was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Bo cau hap ngai cuu in Vinh — steamed pigeon
seoDescription: Bồ câu hấp ngải cứu is steamed pigeon with mugwort, ordered in place of the porridge.
